Cache Management

Static assets are cached via Cloudflare's CDN with headers set in functions/[[path]].js (immutable for hashed assets, short TTL for HTML/XML/JSON). Purge the cache from the Cloudflare dashboard (Caching → Configuration → Purge Everything) after major content updates.
